scope: Native command diagnostic, not WorldEdit throughput or a production root-cause finding
javaVersion:
openjdk version "25.0.4.1" 2026-08-18
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (Red_Hat-25.0.4.1.1-1) (build 25.0.4.1+1)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (Red_Hat-25.0.4.1.1-1) (build 25.0.4.1+1, mixed mode, sharing)
limitations: Command round trip includes console queue, tick scheduling and barrier; not pure command CPU time
cubve.ServerTick excludes queued tasks before tickServer and work between ticks
No connected clients: no player packet fanout or client rendering load
save-all flush is a synchronous explicit flush, not normal incremental autosave
Inclusive sampled frames overlap and are not percentages of elapsed time
First forced flush also persists initial world and the new generation areas, so it is not equal work to later flushes
Tick/stack windows include command, one-second settle and a second barrier; tick events are selected by end/commit timestamp

metricNotes.tickTimes: Existing cubve.ServerTick duration (tickServer work only); events selected by end/commit timestamp
metricNotes.commandRoundTripMs: Console command through completion feedback and barrier, including scheduling/queueing
metricNotes.gcPauseMs: Window overlap with top-level jdk.GCPhasePause, not whole garbage collection duration
metricNotes.samples: Inclusive sampled frames; overlapping counts are not elapsed-time percentages
